seoTitle: Add Google AdSense Code to Squarespace
metaDescription: Learn how to sign up for Google AdSense, generate an ad code, and add it to a Squarespace page or site-wide footer to start earning ad revenue.
intro: Adding Google AdSense to your Squarespace site lets you start earning money by displaying ads. This guide covers signing up for AdSense, generating your ad code, and adding it to a specific page or across your entire site.

steps.heading: Sign up for Google AdSense
steps.body: Create an AdSense account with your Gmail, add your website URL, and submit it for review, making sure your site has enough content and follows AdSense guidelines.

steps.heading: Generate your ad code
steps.body: Once approved, go to the Ads section in your AdSense dashboard, choose By Ad Unit, create a new ad, and copy the generated code.

steps.heading: Log in to Squarespace
steps.body: Open your Squarespace account and go to the website where you want to display ads.

steps.heading: Add the code to a specific page
steps.body: Click Edit on the page, add a Code Block, paste your AdSense code, and uncheck Display Source before saving.

steps.heading: Add the code site-wide
steps.body: To show ads on every page, go to Design and then Footer, add a code block there, and paste your ad code.

steps.heading: Wait for ads to appear
steps.body: It may take a few hours or up to a day for ads to start showing after your code is added and verified.

faq.question: Do I need AdSense approval before adding the code?
faq.answer: Yes, your AdSense account and website need to be approved before you generate and add the ad code.

faq.question: Where do I add the AdSense code in Squarespace?
faq.answer: You add it using a Code Block, either on a specific page or in the Footer for site-wide display.

faq.question: How long does it take for ads to show up?
faq.answer: It can take a few hours or up to a day for ads to appear after adding and verifying the code.

faq.question: Can I show ads on every page at once?
faq.answer: Yes, adding the code block in the Footer under Design displays ads across your entire site.

faq.question: What setting should I uncheck when adding the code?
faq.answer: Make sure to uncheck Display Source in the Code Block so the ad renders instead of showing raw code.
